description: Separate post hoc local-band high-penalty certificate; does not replace original (0,t] certificate
authorization: Parent authorized focused K100 local1pct/5pct bands, same archived splits, no refitting
signed_interval_rho: v=B_a-B_b in [l=B_s,a-B_t,b,u=B_t,a-B_s,b]; zlow=A_s max(l,0)+A_t min(l,0), zup=A_t max(u,0)+A_s min(u,0); rho=||max(abs(zlow),abs(zup))||2
threshold: if every competing m_ab exceeds 1e-10*(1+abs(vote_s,a)+abs(vote_t,b)), Lambda=(1+1e-10) max_b ||r_t||2 rho_ab/m_ab+1e-10; all sigma in [s,t] and finite lambda>=Lambda
normalization: spectral norm(A_t), computed eigvalsh; also store trace(A_t). Original objective sum of squares, no N scaling.
denominators: Complete evaluation query set per seed; summarize unweighted means/sampleSD across five seeds; 40 bands
no_fitting: Only H, B=H^TY, A=H^TH, small eigenvalue computation for scale; no readout solution
censoring: Queries failing interval margin receive infinite threshold, included as uncertified at all finite thresholds
numeric_status: float64 numerical guard; no outward-rounded rigorous arithmetic
